{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Military training regimen''' was the training program used to bring recruits in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] to the highest levels of discipline and skill. The regimen was developed by [[Odile Vaiken]], the first [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the Empire, and remained in place for over a millennium.
